note: Subject layer of the Candy unit redesign (bead pulp_wars-2o7.3): three concepts for the basic line unit that is no longer a pink gumdrop, and the walking gumball machine. Exploration only; see docs/art/factions/CANDY.md.

subjects.UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER/CHOCOLATE: Subject: a chunky cute living chocolate bar soldier with no separate head and no neck: the whole figure is one big thick upright rectangular bar of glossy milk chocolate brown, colour #7a4526, marked into six square blocks with lighter #a8683a top edges and darker #4a2412 grooves, with one hard white highlight; one small bite is missing from its top corner; a torn wrapper of cream paper with a thin cotton-candy pink stripe is pulled down round its lower third like trousers; the face is on the bar itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small happy smile; two tiny stubby chocolate arms and two tiny round dark chocolate feet; it holds one oversized pretzel-stick spear of golden biscuit with a pointed white sugar tip upright in one hand, and a small round pale biscuit wafer shield with a waffle grid on its other arm; no helmet, no hair and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER/TOFFEE: Subject: a chunky cute living wrapped toffee soldier with no separate head and no neck: the whole figure is one big fat rounded cube of glossy golden caramel toffee, colour #e0a040, shaded #b06a1c, inside a clear shiny wrapper whose two twisted fan-shaped ends of pale lemon yellow paper stick out wide on the left and on the right of the cube like big ears; one hard white highlight; the face is on the cube itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small determined smile; two tiny stubby caramel arms and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet; it holds one oversized round lollipop mace, a mint green and white swirl disc on a white stick, upright in one hand, and a small square dark chocolate shield marked into four blocks on its other arm; no helmet, no hair and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER/PEPPERMINT: Subject: a chunky cute living peppermint sweet soldier with no separate head and no neck: the whole figure is one big fat round hard-candy disc seen from the front, glossy white with six bold mint green stripes, colour #3fbf8a, swirling out from its centre like a pinwheel, with one hard white highlight, and two short twisted fan-shaped ends of clear white wrapper sticking out at its left and right; the face is in the middle of the disc itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small happy smile; two tiny stubby white arms and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet directly under the disc; it holds one oversized candy-cane spear with mint green and white stripes and a hooked top upright in one hand, and a small round dark chocolate shield on its other arm; no helmet, no hair and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN/MACHINE: Subject: a chunky cute walking gumball machine that shoots gumballs: on top one very big round clear glass globe, almost as wide as the image, with one hard white highlight, packed full of many small round glossy gumballs in mixed bright colours, apple green, lemon yellow, amber orange, sky blue, white and a few pink; a small round golden toffee lid cap on top of the globe; under the globe a short squat rounded base of glossy golden caramel toffee, colour #e0a040, shaded #b06a1c, with two round black dot eyes, and below the eyes a wide dark open chute like a round mouth out of which one green gumball is flying forward with two short white speed lines; a small round dark chocolate coin knob on its side; two short stubby dark chocolate brown legs with round feet under the base; no arms, no hat and no weapon; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN/MACHINE_MINT: Subject: a chunky cute walking gumball machine that shoots gumballs: on top one very big round clear glass globe, almost as wide as the image, with one hard white highlight, packed full of many small round glossy gumballs in mixed bright colours, apple green, lemon yellow, amber orange, sky blue, white and a few pink; a small round dark chocolate lid cap on top of the globe; under the globe a short squat rounded base of glossy peppermint mint green candy, colour #5fcf9f, shaded #2f9a70, with one white stripe round it and two round black dot eyes, and below the eyes a wide dark open chute like a round mouth out of which one yellow gumball is flying forward with two short white speed lines; a small round golden caramel coin knob on its side; two short stubby dark chocolate brown legs with round feet under the base; no arms, no hat and no weapon; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:FIGHTER/TOFFEE: Subject: a close-up portrait of a chunky cute living wrapped toffee soldier: one big fat rounded cube of glossy golden caramel toffee, colour #e0a040, shaded #b06a1c, with one hard white highlight, filling most of the square, with two twisted fan-shaped wrapper ends of pale lemon yellow and white paper sticking out wide at its left and right like big ears, and a small dark chocolate knob on its top; the face is on the cube itself, two big round black dot eyes under short determined brows, two small pink cheeks and a small smile; beside it the top of a round mint green and white swirl lollipop.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN/MACHINE: Subject: a close-up portrait of a chunky cute living gumball machine: one very big round clear glass globe with a hard white highlight, packed with small round glossy gumballs in mixed bright colours, apple green, lemon yellow, amber orange, sky blue, white and a few pink, with a small round dark chocolate lid cap on its top, filling the upper two thirds of the square; under it the top of a rounded base of glossy mint green candy, colour #5fcf9f, with two round black dot eyes and a wide happy open mouth, and a round golden caramel coin knob on its side.
